source.title: Structure of the F-actin-tropomyosin complex
source.citation: von der Ecken J, Muller M, Lehman W, Manstein DJ, Penczek PA, Raunser S. Structure of the F-actin-tropomyosin complex. Nature 2015;519(7541):114-7. doi:10.1038/nature14033
source.organisms: Actin of rabbit skeletal muscle, tropomyosin of mouse

source.note: A filament assembled from purified proteins. The actin is of rabbit and the tropomyosin of mouse. Tropomyosin was resolved to 6.5 angstrom only.
